reason: A proper VAT e-invoice with my company tax code plus VietQR payment fixes my monthly fight with the accountant, and DeepSeek/Qwen at official price with no markup is fine. I'd take the 50k free credit, test it, then top up a small amount once.
objection: Who is this company and will they still be here in six months? If a provider cuts off a reseller, my production calls break, and I'm trusting a newcomer with my keys and traffic.
would_change_my_mind: If the e-invoice turns out to be a generic receipt instead of a real VAT invoice, or the rate is worse than the published bank rate, I walk.
